constraints.text: holdsHandle = {} (no client holds a relay handle)
connState /= connected => no valid KV/stream/names handles
ClientAttach: client joins attached; no second record or dial
ClientAttachRefused: absent daemon is named notRunning, never hangs
Request(reqTimeout) on the current generation moves connected to halfOpen
StaleRequestTimeout (owner? < generation) is a no-op on the live connection
ForceReconnect from halfOpen tears down a genuinely wedged client
FlushWindowForceTeardown then late epoch callback heals
EnsureConnected fresh dial resets reconnectEpoch and advances generation
Subscribe guard subGen(k) < generation re-binds a stranded SUB
Subscribe is a no-op when subGen(k) = generation
SubscribeRetry: a failed subscribe is retried at the next liveness wake
SnapshotDone moves the watcher to streaming, never to idle or stopped
HandleError restarts the watcher (only HandleError raises restartCount)

uncovered.suggestion: Kill the daemon with a client attached; assert the client's connection is gone and the attached set is empty
Attempt relay close while a client is attached; assert it is refused or the clients are dropped first

uncovered.text: daemon = daemonAbsent => connState = disconnected, generation = 0, every subGen(k) = 0, phase = idle, restartCount = 0
uncovered.suggestion: Start a daemon after a kill and assert a pristine relay: no connection, generation 0, no subscription, idle watcher
uncovered.testPattern: assert (state, generation, sub_gens, phase, restarts) == (DISCONNECTED, 0, {k: 0}, IDLE, 0)

uncovered.text: ClientAttach leaves the relay untouched: attaching to a disconnected relay causes no dial
uncovered.suggestion: Attach to a daemon whose relay is disconnected; assert connState and dial count unchanged until the first request

uncovered.text: ClientAttach precondition connState /= closed (daemon in shutdown)
ClientAttachRefused: closed relay is named relayClosed
uncovered.suggestion: Attach while the relay is closed; the daemon answers relayClosed

uncovered.text: ClientDetach leaves connection, generation and always-on subscriptions unchanged (last client gone)
uncovered.suggestion: Detach the last client; assert generation, subGen and connState are the same

uncovered.text: DaemonExit enabled in every transport state, halfOpen and closed included
uncovered.suggestion: Wedge the relay (halfOpen), kill and restart the daemon; assert recovery

uncovered.text: DaemonExit resets connection, generation, epoch, subscriptions and watcher; the KV sessions survive
uncovered.suggestion: Kill the daemon, restart, assert presence rows remain and all relay counters are initial

uncovered.text: DaemonStart dials nothing; the first request dials
uncovered.suggestion: Start the daemon; assert zero relay connections until the first request

uncovered.text: EnsureConnected and EnsureConnectFailed require daemon = daemonUp
uncovered.suggestion: No relay socket is ever opened outside a running daemon (client processes import no engine)

uncovered.text: Close requires daemon = daemonUp and attached = {}
uncovered.suggestion: Daemon shutdown closes the relay only after the last client has detached
